scripts/swarm/publish_gate.py:scripts.sw.reason: Replaces rsplit(" ", 1) with split(" ", 1) on the unit label. Every label is built as "file lines", f"{name} lines" or f"{name} {code}", where name is a size_limits qualified name (identifiers, dots, optional #n) and code is a ruff code, so it holds exactly one space and no other whitespace; every variant yields the same leading name.
